heading: You are already with us
message: Someone — we hope you — asked for M'Arte letters at this address. You are already on our list, so there is nothing to confirm: you will keep hearing from the atelier about new pieces and quiet news.
messageSecondary: If this was not you, simply ignore this email. Nothing has changed.
unsubscribeNote: You can leave the list at any time from the link at the bottom of every letter.
